content:
After the major update in August for Madden NFL 27, Apple Arcade will add "two beloved puzzle games" to its ad-free platform in September.

Block Blast!+ and Art of Fauna: Cozy Puzzles+ will be joining Apple's gaming subscription service in September.

Apple has announced that the September Arcade update will bring two new puzzle games to the platform: Block Blast!+ and Art of Fauna: Cozy Puzzles+. Both titles will land on Apple Arcade starting Thursday, September 3.

From the screenshots, Block Blast!+ looks especially suited for anyone looking for a Tetris-style game.

Art of Fauna, on the other hand, offers a slower-paced, more relaxed gaming experience with what it calls "nature-style art."

As with all games on Apple Arcade, there are no ads or in-app purchases. Everything is included with the Apple Arcade subscription.

Apple also highlighted additional new content coming to Arcade through the end of August, starting tomorrow:

You can read the full announcement here.

Apple Arcade offers an ad-free, no in-app purchases experience for $6.99 per month after a one-month free trial. A single subscription can be shared with up to five users through Family Sharing.

Every Apple One bundle includes Apple Arcade.
